g.text: FACTLINE V1: SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & FORENSIC DATAFLOW
Autonomous News Credibility Engine • Multi-Modal Claims Forensic Grounding • Real-Time Distributed Telemetry
User Narrative Binding: Suspicion prompts & source bias focus
Uvicorn ASGI • Pydantic v2 • JWT Security Middleware
→ Dispatched immediately without blocking client HTTP thread
FastAPI WebSocket server subscribes to channel and relays
instantly to user's Flutter phone HUD at 60 FPS.
BeautifulSoup4 Web Crawler • Tesseract Optical Character Recognition
• Scrapes raw HTML article body via custom User-Agent and strips script/style tags.
• If image: Runs pytesseract.image_to_string() and checks C2PA provenance signatures.
• Queries NewsOutlet whitelist (Reuters, AP, BBC, PIB) or blocks on blacklisted domains.
Prompt: Professional News Editor • Filter Bias Fluff • Standardize Core Content
• Strips sensational clickbait adjectives and isolates uncorroborated assertions.
• Saves cleaned text into post.refined_body for reproducible semantic downstream audit.
• Implements exponential backoff with quota retry protection against Gemini 429 errors.
Multilingual Detection (EN, HI, MR) • Extract ≥5 Verifiable Propositions
• Categorizes claims into: QUANTITATIVE (statistics), ATTRIBUTION (quotes), EVENT (incidents).
• Emits structured schema: { short_title, summary_easy, tags, language, claims: [...] }.
Qdrant Vector Database (Port 6333) • Pre-Ingested LIAR Dataset Benchmarks
• Calculates dense vector cosine similarity against 12,000+ vetted historical claims.
• Flags recurring recycled urban legends, old hoaxes, or previously debunked narratives.
Final Forensic Grounding Verdict • Relational SQL Persistence
• Consolidates Search Evidence + Vector Distance + Source Scores into single audit.
• Commits to PostgreSQL tables: Post, Claim, ClaimSource, RedFlag, TrustSignal.
• Reuters, Associated Press, BBC, The Hindu
• Official rebuttals, policy PDFs, court records
• Matches existing forensic rulings on rumor
5. MULTI-VECTOR FORENSIC SCORING MATRIX & VERDICT GENERATION
GAN warp artifacts, stripped camera headers.
AUDIT VERDICT TIERS (UI BADGES & USER MEANING):
id, title, body, refined_body, credibility_score, status, raw_json
post_id, text, verdict, confidence, reason, historical_ctx, source_url
post_id, signal (whitelisted domain, HTTPS), flag (TLD, GAN artifact)
7. END-TO-END STATE TRANSITION LIFECYCLE & DOCKER ORCHESTRATION
